recipe.visualDefinition: A centered studio portrait of three performers (a man flanked by two women) against a dark, warm-toned vignette background. The man is dressed in all-white leisure attire, while the women wear matching red and white sequined bell-bottom outfits. The lighting creates a soft halo effect around the central figures, transitioning from a warm amber center to deep brown edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Central male figure acts as the vertical axis for the composition.
Symmetrical placement of female figures creates a balanced triangular weight.
High contrast between the white central suit and the dark peripheral background.
Color coordination between the red outfits and the red secondary typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body trio centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's white shirt and crossed arms at the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-center text, moves down to the central male face, then radiates outward to the flanking female figures and their flared trousers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep brown/black negative space surrounding the subjects, concentrated at the top corners and bottom edges.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright White (Central figure and outfit accents)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cinnabar Red (Female outfits and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white clothing and dark background; muted saturation in the background with pops of saturated red.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stress in O and C
Uniform stroke weight for the secondary line
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is smaller and centered between the primary names
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for names paired with a bold, condensed sans-serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the sharp serifs and high contrast of the primary text.
Matches the condensed, bold weight of the secondary red text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man in a white 70s leisure suit standing between two women in red and white sequined bell-bottom outfits. The background is a dark brown vignette with a warm amber glow behind the subjects. Soft lighting, 1970s film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text at the top. The first line in a large white serif font. The second line in a medium-sized, bold, condensed red font.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered at the top?
Is the background a warm brown vignette?
Are the outfits period-accurate (bell bottoms, leisure suit)?
Is the color palette restricted to white, red, and brown?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the outfits and text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the performers
Any specific brand logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check for proper serif contrast in the primary text.
Ensure the red text is noticeably condensed compared to the white text.
Verify the 'halo' lighting effect behind the central figures.
Confirm the bell-bottom silhouette is prominent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + 70s Fashion + Warm Vignette + Stacked Centered Typography (Serif White / Condensed Red)
